items.source: Clears all indexed tools for the specified session.
items.translation: 清除指定会话中的所有索引工具。

items.source: Converts a natural-language query into a case-insensitive OR regex pattern.
items.translation: 将自然语言查询转换为不区分大小写的 OR 正则表达式模式。

items.source: Registers a tool in the search index for the specified session.
items.translation: 为指定会话在搜索索引中注册工具。

items.source:
Registers multiple tools in the search index for the specified session in a single
batch operation.
items.translation: 在单个批量操作中，为指定的会话注册多个工具到搜索索引中。

items.source: Validates a regex pattern without performing a search.
items.translation: 验证正则表达式模式，而不执行搜索。

items.source: Searches for tools matching the given request criteria.
items.translation: 搜索符合给定请求条件的工具。

items.source: Returns the number of tools in the index for the specified session.
items.translation: 返回指定会话中索引中的工具数量。

items.source: Returns the total number of tools across all session indexes.
items.translation: 返回所有会话索引中工具的总数。

items.source: sessionId - the session identifier for tool isolation
items.translation: sessionId - 用于工具隔离的会话标识符

items.source: Implementations should override this method when a batch operation is more efficient than repeated ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference) calls (e.g. a single embedding API call or a single write transaction). The default implementation simply iterates and delegates to ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference).
items.translation: 实现类应在批量操作比重复调用ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference)更高效时（例如单次嵌入 API 调用或单次写入事务）重写此方法。默认实现仅迭代并委托给ToolIndex.indexTool(String, ToolReference)。

items.source: Stop words are filtered out and remaining tokens are escaped and joined into a pattern of the form (?i)(token1|token2|...). Generated patterns are capped at 200 characters. Tool-name matches are weighted 2× higher than description matches.
items.translation: 停用词被过滤掉，剩余的标记经过转义并连接成如下形式的模式：(?i)(token1|token2|...)。生成的模式长度上限为 200 个字符。工具名称匹配的权重是描述匹配的两倍。

items.source: Tokens are lowercased, stop words removed, special regex characters escaped, and joined as (?i)(token1|token2|...). The pattern is truncated if it would exceed 200 characters. Subclasses may override to apply a different conversion strategy.
items.translation: 标记被转换为小写，移除停用词，转义特殊正则表达式字符，并连接为(?i)(token1|token2|...)。如果模式长度超过 200 个字符，则会被截断。子类可以重写此方法以应用不同的转换策略。

items.source:
Regex-based tool searcher that converts natural-language queries into case-insensitive
OR patterns and matches them against tool names and descriptions.
items.translation: 基于正则表达式的工具搜索器，将自然语言查询转换为不区分大小写的 OR 模式，并匹配工具名称和描述。
